image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a street sign assembly mounted on a metal pole. The primary subject is a large, dark blue rectangular sign with white text and symbols that appear distorted and illegible (gibberish). To the right, attached to the same pole, is a smaller, arrow-shaped directional sign, also featuring distorted white lettering. The background includes a light-colored building facade and green foliage on the right side. The lighting suggests daytime.

artifact_observations.location: All text areas on both the main rectangular sign and the arrow sign.
artifact_observations.reasoning: Catastrophic failure of text generation. Characters are melted, merged, inverted, and nonsensical. This is a hallmark AI artifact where the model replicates the texture of text without understanding orthography.

artifact_observations.location: Junction between the arrow sign and the pole.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The arrow sign appears to warp and merge into the pole rather than being mechanically attached. The geometry of the sign's tail is illogical and physically unstable.
The lines of the sign and the text within it do not follow a consistent vanishing point. Some letters appear flat while others seem wrapped around a curve, despite the sign face appearing planar.
The pole has a smeared, painterly texture lacking the distinct longitudinal striations or metallic reflection patterns expected of a galvanized steel street pole.
